1033.description: A seated machine extension that isolates the triceps through a stable path.
instructions: Sit and adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grab the handles with your elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps for a second.
Return slowly without lifting your shoulders.

1097.description: A side bend using a strap. It works the obliques.
instructions: Hold a handle and stand sideways to the anchor.
Brace your core.
Bend sideways away from the anchor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
Keep your hips still.

1161.description: Steady rowing on an indoor machine for full-body cardio conditioning.
instructions: Sit on the machine, strap in your feet and grab the handle with straight arms.
Push through your legs first, then lean back slightly.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs with elbows close.
Reverse the order: arms out, hips hinge, then knees bend to slide forward.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 10-30 minutes at a comfortable pace.

1225.description: Pressing a weight plate overhead with both hands. A simple way to train the shoulders and arms.
instructions: Stand tall holding a plate at the sides with both hands at chest height.
Brace your core and keep your elbows slightly forward.
Press the plate overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it slowly to your chest.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching.

1289.description: Press one dumbbell up on an incline bench to train the upper chest and front shoulder. Working one arm at a time helps balance both sides.
instructions: Adjust the incline bench to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip, resting it on your shoulder.
Push the dumbbell up and away from your body, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳调整至 45 度角。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住哑铃，正手握住，将其放在肩膀上。
将哑铃向上推离身体，完全伸展手臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1353.description: Squat down, then explode up and throw a medicine ball overhead and catch it again. It trains power through the hips, back and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball in both hands at chest level.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Explosively extend your hips and legs, while simultaneously throwing the medicine ball overhead.
Release the ball at the top of the movement and catch it on the way down.
Lower your body back into the squat position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住健身球，与胸部齐平。
稍微弯曲膝盖并启动核心。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持背部挺直、挺胸。
爆发性伸展臀部和腿部，同时将药球扔过头顶。
在动作的最高点释放球并在下降的过程中接住它。
将身体放回蹲姿，然后重复所需的重复次数。

1417.description: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and curl one leg toward you while kicking diagonally. It works the hamstrings, glutes and core.
instructions: Start by lying on your back with your legs extended and your heels resting on top of the stability ball.
Place your arms by your sides for stability.
Engage your glutes and core muscles to lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your shoulders to your heels.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your chest, keeping your left leg extended and your foot flexed.
Kick your right leg diagonally across your body, extending it fully and engaging your hamstrings.
Slowly return your right leg to the starting position, maintaining control and stability.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先仰卧，双腿伸展，脚跟放在稳定球上。
将手臂放在身体两侧以保持稳定。
调动臀肌和核心肌肉，将臀部抬离地面，从肩膀到脚后跟形成一条直线。
弯曲右膝并将其靠近胸部，保持左腿伸展，脚部弯曲。
将右腿斜踢过身体，完全伸展并拉动腿筋。
慢慢地将右腿返回到起始位置，保持控制和稳定性。
用左腿重复该动作，交替进行所需的重复次数。

1481.description: A yoga backbend where you lie on your belly and hold your ankles. It stretches the thighs, chest and front of the hips.
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your arms along your sides.
Bend your knees and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and kick your feet gently into your hands to raise your thighs.
Keep your gaze forward and breathe steadily.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then release slowly and rest on the mat.

1545.description: A squat with the bar held in the crooks of your elbows at full depth. It hits the quads, glutes and upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell in the crooks of your elbows, with your hands gripping the barbell for stability.
Engage your core and keep your chest lifted as you lower your hips back and down into a squat position.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your weight in your heels.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微外翻。
将杠铃放在肘部的弯曲处，双手握住杠铃以保持稳定。
当你将臀部向后降低到蹲姿时，启动你的核心并保持胸部抬起。
保持膝盖与脚趾对齐，并将重量放在脚后跟上。
降低直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
通过脚跟发力站起来，在动作的最高点挤压臀部。
重复所需的重复次数。

1609.description: A one-armed cable pushdown done from the side. It isolates each triceps and lets you focus on form.
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and stand sideways to the machine.
Grip the handle with the arm closest to the stack and keep your elbow at your side.
Push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

1673.description: A preacher curl with the arm supported over an exercise ball. It trains the biceps with some balance demand.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip, resting your elbow on the exercise ball.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，反握，将肘部放在健身球上。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1737.description: Bent-over dumbbell extension that isolates the triceps while you sit and hinge forward. Great for building the back of the upper arm.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your head up.
Extend your arms straight back, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，每只手各握一个哑铃。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，头部抬起。
将手臂向后伸直，保持肘部靠近头部。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1801.description: Reaching one arm overhead and leaning to the side stretches a single lat. Good for finding tight spots on each side.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a pole or frame with one hand above head height.
Lean away from the arm and sit your hips slightly back to feel a stretch along your side.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1865.description: Pull-up with palms facing each other on the dip cage handles, hitting the lats and arms.
instructions: Grab the neutral grip handles with your palms facing each other.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest toward the handles by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bars.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

1929.description: A bent-knee stretch that targets the lower calf and the muscles around the shin.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and the toes pressed against the wall or floor.
Bend the knee of the stretching leg slightly.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch low in the calf.
Keep the heel on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2121.description: Curves the body sideways while lying down, which stretches the flank without any need to balance.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs together and arms stretched overhead.
Slide both feet and both hands to the same side so the body forms a gentle arc.
Keep your hips and shoulders on the floor.
Breathe slowly and relax into the curve.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and bend to the other side.

2249.description: A cable pushdown with a V bar that isolates the back of the upper arm.
instructions: Attach a V bar to a high pulley and stand facing the stack.
Grip the bar with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment at the bottom.
Let the bar rise until your forearms are just past parallel.
Keep your upper arms still throughout the set.

2569.description: A wide side-to-side squat where you sink onto one leg while the other stays straight. It builds leg strength and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet much wider than shoulder width and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips down and back.
Keep the other leg straight with the heel down and toes up.
Push through the bent leg to slide back to the centre.
Repeat on the other side and keep your chest tall.

2761.description: Pulling the toes up toward the shin, working the front of the lower leg. A simple way to keep the ankle moving well.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your heel resting on the floor.
Pull your toes and the top of your foot toward your shin as far as is comfortable.
Pause briefly, then lower the foot back down slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2889.description: A wide-limb crunch that works the abs while your arms and legs open and close like a starfish.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Crunch up, bringing your arms and legs toward the center.
Slowly open back out to the starfish shape.
Keep your movements controlled and repeat.

3017.description: A pendlay row from the floor, pulling the barbell to your upper abdomen. Builds the upper back and lats.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the barbell towards your upper abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃拉向上腹部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将杠铃降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3145.description: A push-up finished with an extra shove that spreads the shoulder blades at the top. It trains the chest and the serratus muscles that stabilise the shoulder blades.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Once your chest is just above the ground, push through your hands to extend your arms and lift your upper body up.
At the top of the movement, protract your shoulder blades by pushing your upper back towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement by retracting your shoulder blades and lowering your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
一旦你的胸部刚好高于地面，用力推动你的手臂，伸展你的手臂并抬起你的上半身。
在动作的最高点，将上背部推向天花板，从而伸展肩胛骨。
暂停片刻，然后通过缩回肩胛骨并将身体放回起始位置来反转动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

3337.description: A side plank with a dumbbell held on your hip or raised overhead. It trains the obliques and lateral stability.
instructions: Lie on one side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Hold a dumbbell on your top hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds without sagging.
Lower, then repeat on the other side.

3401.description: A pike push-up with your feet on one bench and your hands between benches for extra depth.
instructions: Put your feet on one bench and your hands on the floor or a second bench.
Raise your hips into a pike.
Lower your head between your hands.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.

3465.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 5 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3529.description: A landmine move combining a stand-up with a high knee drive. It trains the legs and core.
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at your chest.
Stand from a squat, driving through your legs.
Raise one knee high as you stand.
Lower the foot and squat again.
Keep the barbell close to your chest.
Alternate legs each rep.

3593.description: The classic barbell squat that builds strength in the thighs and hips.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.

3657.description: Hold a lying position on your back with a pad as a reference for setup and posture.
instructions: Place a pad on the floor or bench.
Lie on your back with your head supported.
Keep your spine neutral.
Relax your arms at your sides.
Hold the position and breathe.

3721.description: A bent-over row with a wide overhand grip that emphasises the upper back and rear delts.
instructions: Hold a barbell with a wide overhand grip and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let the bar hang at arm length below your chest.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest, flaring your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar with control.

3785.description: An incline push-up with the hands on a box. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps with less load than a floor push-up.
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a box or elevated surface, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the box by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将双手放在盒子或高架表面的边缘，距离略宽于肩宽。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向箱子方向降低，保持身体呈一条直线。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3913.description: A one-arm raise in front of you that trains the front delts.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thigh.
Keep your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms after your reps.

3977.description: A push up followed by a hand reaching to the opposite toe. It adds core and mobility work to the chest drill.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower your chest and push back up.
Lift your hips and reach one hand to the opposite foot.
Return to plank.
Alternate hands each rep.

4041.description: Rotating a dumbbell side to side while balanced on a stability ball. It challenges the obliques and balance.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it, hips lifted.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Rotate your torso and arms to one side.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your hips high and move with control.

4105.description: A trap bar deadlift while standing on a raised platform, increasing range of motion for legs and back.
instructions: Stand on a low platform inside the trap bar.
Squat down and grip the handles with a flat back.
Brace and push the floor away.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower the bar with control to the start.

4169.description: A single leg squat with an explosive jump at the top. It trains leg power and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other extended forward.
Lower into a single leg squat.
Explode upward off the standing leg.
Land softly on the same leg.
Sink back into the next squat.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

4233.description: A one-arm wrist curl, palm up, seated with a weight. It builds the forearm flexors and grip.
instructions: Sit and rest one forearm on your thigh, palm up.
Let the weight roll toward your fingertips.
Curl your wrist up as far as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

4361.description: A shoulder shrug without weight for warming up or light trap work.
instructions: Stand tall with arms by your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Lower them slowly.
Avoid rolling your shoulders.

4425.description: A chest-supported row lying on a rack with a neutral grip, working the lats and mid back.
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench or rack with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row the dumbbells toward your ribs, keeping elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.

4489.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the area between the spine and shoulder blade (rhomboids). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your area between the spine and shoulder blade (rhomboids) while leaning back against a wall.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4553.description: A bridge-like drill that opens the upper back and shoulders while rotating the spine.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and one hand behind you.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Reach your free arm up and over, rotating your chest toward the ceiling.
Open your chest as far as feels comfortable.
Return to the start under control.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides.

4617.description: An easier one-arm push-up using a wall, building the strength and stability needed for the full floor version.
instructions: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place one hand on it at chest height.
Keep your other arm behind your back or at your side.
Bend your elbow to lower your chest toward the wall, body in a straight line.
Press back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

4681.description: Pressing one leg at a time against a band while lying down. It builds leg strength with light equipment.
instructions: Lie on your back and loop the band around the soles of your feet, holding the ends.
Bend both knees toward your chest.
Press one foot out straight against the band.
Bring it back and press the other leg.
Alternate smoothly with control.

4745.description: An Arnold press done from a kneeling position, which takes the legs out and challenges your core. It trains all three heads of the shoulder.
instructions: Kneel tall holding dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press up while rotating your palms to face forward.
Finish with your arms straight overhead.
Reverse the rotation as you lower back to the start.

4937.description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench with a rounded upper back. This shifts the focus onto the glutes.
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench with your ankles locked.
Cross your arms over your chest and round your upper back slightly.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips.
Squeeze the glutes to raise back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Avoid overarching your lower back.

5001.description: Seated rotation with a light dumbbell that trains the muscles on the back of the shoulder. It supports healthy shoulders.
instructions: Sit holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
Rest your arm on your thigh or a pad for support.
Rotate your forearm upward and outward, keeping the elbow in place.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

5065.description: Rotate a light dumbbell forward with your upper arm held out at shoulder height. It strengthens the internal rotators of the shoulder.
instructions: Lie on your side or stand with your upper arm out at 90 degrees and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Hold a light dumbbell with the forearm pointing up.
Rotate your forearm forward and down without moving the upper arm.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start, then switch arms after your reps.

5129.description: A seated twist of the upper body. It mobilises the spine and warms up the obliques.
instructions: Sit tall with arms crossed on your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to the centre.
Rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly without forcing the twist.

5193.description: Dragging a weighted sled backward while walking. It builds thigh strength with very little joint impact.
instructions: Load the sled and grip the handles or strap in front of you.
Lean slightly back with your chest up.
Walk backward in small, powerful steps.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Cover your distance, then rest and repeat.

5385.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shoulder blade. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your shoulder blade.
Place the roller under the shoulder blade and let your body weight settle onto it.
Reach your top arm forward and back as you roll.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5449.description: Curl the dumbbells while dragging them up along your body, with elbows moving back. Keeps tension on the biceps.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl the weights up, keeping them close to your torso.
Let your elbows travel slightly back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso still.

5513.description: Bench dip with your feet on a stability ball for extra instability, hammering the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench edge with hands beside your hips and heels on a stability ball.
Slide your hips off the bench with arms straight.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees, keeping them close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulders down and the ball steady.

5577.description: Sumo deadlift with a pause just off the floor to build strength out of the bottom.
instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and pull the slack out of the bar.
Lift the bar a few centimetres and pause for 1-2 seconds.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall.
Lower the bar under control.

5705.description: A powerful pull from the floor that sends the bar to chest height. It develops explosive hips, traps and shoulders.
instructions: Set up over the bar with feet hip-width apart and a flat back.
Lift the bar to your knees with your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up to chest height with elbows high and outside.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

5897.description: A half child's pose with arms reaching forward and hips high. Opens the shoulders and the back.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with your hips over your knees.
Walk your hands forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep your hips high above your knees.
Rest your forehead down and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Walk your hands back to return.

6025.description: A prone move where both knees bend outward like a frog and kick up, to work the glutes.
instructions: Lie face down, knees bent and heels together.
Let your knees fall slightly out.
Lift both thighs off the floor by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

6537.description: A push-up combined with a pulling motion, adding upper-back work to a classic chest exercise.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up.
Press back up to the top.
Drag one hand across the floor as if pulling yourself forward.
Alternate sides and keep your core tight.

6601.description: A glute press on a lever machine that targets your glutes by pushing your hips and legs back against resistance.
instructions: Position yourself on the machine and set your feet on the platform.
Brace your core.
Press the platform away by driving through your heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.

6793.description: A forward-fold style check of how flexible the back of your body is, from calves up to your lower back.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your knees straight.
Hinge at the hips and slowly reach down toward your toes.
Let your head and arms hang relaxed without bouncing.
Note how far your fingertips reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Rise slowly, rolling up one vertebra at a time.

7113.description: A pullover variation with straight arms that stretches and works the chest and lats through a long arc.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Keep a slight softness in your elbows and brace your core.
Lower the weight in an arc back over your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips on the bench.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest.
Repeat with a smooth tempo.

7177.description: A seated machine press working one calf at a time to build lower leg strength.
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Rest the other foot on the floor or the support.
Press up through your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calf.
Lower your heel slowly for a full stretch.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7561.description: Supported single leg squat that helps you progress toward the full version.
instructions: Hold a stable support with one hand.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted.
Lower down as far as you can with control.
Use the support only as much as needed.
Push up and switch legs.

7625.description: A biceps curl performed while hinged forward at the hips. The position removes swing and keeps tension on the biceps.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, elbows fixed.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

8585.description: A simple drill that squeezes the elbows back to engage the mid back. It trains the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your hands by your head or elbows bent in front.
Pull your elbows back and down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your neck relaxed.

9609.description: A hip hinge lifting a kettlebell from the floor. It teaches solid deadlift mechanics and builds the posterior chain.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with a flat back.
Brace your core and push the floor away.
Stand fully tall, squeezing your glutes.
Lower the bell back to the floor with control.

9865.description: A belt-machine deadlift using a V handle, so the load hangs from your hips.
instructions: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the V bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
Lower with control.

9929.description: A single leg squat on a hack squat machine. It adds stability while loading one leg at a time.
instructions: Set your back against the pad and step onto the platform.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Lower into a squat with control.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

10057.description: From a reverse tabletop, you hop your feet apart and together like a jumping jack. It works the glutes and legs.
instructions: Sit with hands behind you, then lift hips into a tabletop with knees bent.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips high.
Hop your feet wide.
Hop them back together.
Keep going at a steady pace.
Keep your hips high and don't let them sag.

10185.description: A row from a bear plank position that builds back strength while the core fights to stop hip rotation.
instructions: Start on all fours with a dumbbell in each hand and knees hovering just off the floor.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it back to the floor with control.
Row with the other arm and keep alternating at a steady pace.

10761.description: A sideways walk on your toes against band tension. It works calves, ankles and outer hips.
instructions: Place a band around your ankles.
Rise onto your toes with knees slightly bent.
Step sideways in small steps.
Keep tension on the band.
Do not let your heels drop.
Walk one way, then back.

11017.description: A one-arm overhead press done on both knees. The kneeling position takes the legs out so your shoulder and core do the work.
instructions: Kneel on both knees with your hips tall and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder without leaning sideways.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

11273.description: A lying cable fly that stretches and squeezes the chest. The cables keep tension on at the top.
instructions: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand over your chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop at a comfortable stretch.
Bring the handles back together over your chest.

11529.description: A single-leg hip hinge on a belt-loaded lever machine that trains hamstrings and glutes with extra balance support.
instructions: Fasten the belt and stand on one leg on the platform with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and push them back as your torso lowers.
Let the free leg extend behind you for balance.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, then switch legs after your reps.

11657.description: A reverse lunge while holding a plate overhead, which trains the legs and challenges shoulder and core stability.
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your ribs down and the plate stable over your head.
Push through the front foot to return, then alternate legs.

11785.description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill that trains internal rotation.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm across your belly.
Move slowly through a comfortable range.
Return to the start and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

0009.description: A machine-assisted chest dip performed from a kneeling pad, so you can train dips with less of your bodyweight.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired height and secure your knees on the pad.
Grasp the handles with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将机器调整到您想要的高度，并将膝盖固定在垫子上。
手掌朝下，抓住手柄，双臂完全伸展。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地板平行。
暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0073.description: Lying on a bench, you lower the bar behind your head with straight arms and bring it back over the chest. Works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold a barbell with a shoulder-width grip and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Keeping your arms straight, lower the barbell behind your head in a controlled manner until you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pause for a moment, then raise the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，头放在一端，双脚放在地板上。
握距与肩同宽，握住杠铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持手臂伸直，以受控的方式将杠铃降低到头后，直到感觉到背阔肌被拉伸。
暂停片刻，然后将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0137.description: A bodyweight press-up that pushes the body back toward the hands. Trains the triceps.
instructions: Start by placing your hands on a raised surface, such as a bench or parallel bars, with your palms facing down and fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs out in front of you, keeping your heels on the ground and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides, until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先将双手放在凸起的表面上，例如长凳或双杠上，手掌朝下，手指向前。
将双腿向前方伸展，脚跟保持在地面上，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部降低身体，使其靠近身体两侧，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后用手掌伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0201.description: The classic triceps pushdown on a high pulley with a straight bar. Elbows stay at your sides while the forearms drive down.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and push the bar down until your elbows are fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then inhale and slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向下推，直到肘部完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0329.description: A shrug using dumbbells on an incline bench. Lifting the shoulders trains the traps.
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Place your feet flat on the ground and let your arms hang straight down with your palms facing your body.
Keeping your arms straight, shrug your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将上斜凳设置为 45 度角，坐在上面，双手各握一个哑铃。
将双脚平放在地面上，让双臂笔直下垂，手掌朝向身体。
保持手臂伸直，耸肩，尽可能高地靠近耳朵。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0393.description: A seated curl that emphasises the inner part of the biceps. You keep the elbows tight and curl with control.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Rest your upper arms on your thighs, allowing the dumbbells to hang down.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心朝上。
将上臂放在大腿上，让哑铃垂下。
保持上臂不动，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀方向卷曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0457.description: A sit-up with the arms straight. It works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and arms straight above your head.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground while simultaneously lifting your legs towards your chest.
Reach your hands towards your toes as you lift your upper body and legs.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，双臂伸直至头顶上方。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，同时将双腿抬向胸部。
抬起上半身和腿部时，将双手伸向脚趾。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低上半身和双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0521.description: In a push-up position holding kettlebells, you row one at a time. It builds the back and core.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands gripping the kettlebells and your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull one kettlebell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position and repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手握住壶铃，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
收紧核心肌群，保持身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
将一个壶铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
将壶铃放回起始位置，然后用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

0585.description: Seated on a machine, you straighten your legs against a pad. A simple quad builder.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the machine to fit your body.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footpad.
Grasp the handles or sidebars for stability.
Extend your legs forward by straightening your knees, lifting the weight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the weight back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整机器的座椅高度和靠背以适合您的身体。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚放在脚垫上。
抓住手柄或侧杆以保持稳定性。
伸直膝盖，举起重物，向前伸展双腿。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将重量放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0649.description: A twisting stretch lying on your side. It loosens the hips, trunk and lower back.
instructions: Lie on one side and bend your top knee.
Pull the bottom foot toward your glutes.
Rotate your top knee back toward the floor behind you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

0713.description: A simple side-bend stretch for the muscles along the side of your neck and top of the shoulders.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head so your ear moves toward one shoulder.
Keep the opposite shoulder pressed down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Don't pull hard on your head, a light weight of the hand is enough.

0777.description: A rotational move with a dumbbell, sweeping the weight across the body from low to high. It trains the abs and obliques and builds control.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the waist, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arm with the dumbbell towards the opposite foot, rotating your torso as you do so.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，腰部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将哑铃伸向另一只脚的手臂，同时旋转躯干。
返回起始位置并在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0841.description: A pull-up with added weight on a belt or vest. It builds the lats and biceps and increases strength.
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，保持肘部靠近身体。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0905.description: A kneeling pulldown with a band anchored overhead. It trains the lats and mid-back.
instructions: Anchor the band high and kneel facing it.
Grab the ends with arms extended up.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control.

0969.description: A V-up with a band, alternating the leg position each rep. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engage your abs and lift your legs and upper body off the ground simultaneously, reaching your hands towards your toes.
As you lower your legs and upper body back down, switch the position of your legs, crossing one over the other.
Repeat the movement, alternating the position of your legs with each repetition.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，手臂伸过头顶，握住弹力带。
收紧腹肌，同时将双腿和上半身抬离地面，将双手伸向脚趾。
当你降低双腿和上半身时，交换双腿的位置，将一条腿交叉在另一条腿上。
重复该动作，每次重复时交替变换双腿的位置。
继续进行所需的重复次数。
